description: Explicit NO KBF ↔ NIS2 dual-mapping for Norwegian energy-sector operators subject to both Kraftberedskapsforskriften and EU NIS2 (national transposition). Used for cross-framework evidence packs and audit traceability.
jurisdictionNote: Norwegian grid operators (KBO-enheter) may be essential entities under NIS2 Annex I energy sector while also subject to NVE Kraftberedskapsforskriften. Dual mappings are contributing/partial — not automatic legal equivalence.

assuranceReview.policy: NIS2 dual-mapping entries on KBF-tagged UCs must use contributing or partial assurance only. Splunk telemetry supports cross-framework evidence packs; it does not establish legal equivalence between NO KBF paragraphs and NIS2 articles.
